name: minimax/minimax-m2.5
description: MiniMax-M2.5 is a MiniMax M2-series language model released in February 2026 for real-world productivity, trained with reinforcement learning across hundreds of thousands of complex real-world environments. MiniMax highlights coding across more than ten languages and the full development lifecycle, planning projects like a software architect before writing code, plus agentic search, tool use and office work. MiniMax now lists it as a legacy model behind M2.7 and M3.
